summary: Iteration 14 — Edit & Finish frontend wire-up + query-token media auth regression. Route `/edit-finish` now renders EditFinish page (was ComingSoon). Verified end-to-end: student login → sidebar → page mounts with `Neon Heart` preselected, all 5 tabs present, new version creation works, dummy MP4 upload → `<video>` renders with `?token=<jwt>` in src, video URL returns 200 with token and 401 without. Accessibility checklist has 7 items, delivery has 8 items, final gate initially RED with correct blockers. Credits (opening + closing), finishing (category/body/add + 4 buckets), captions add-btn all present. Story Lab + Sync Studio smoke passed with 0 console errors — resolveAssetUrl token-append does not break any existing media. Backend regression: 222/222 pytest (220 existing + 2 new in test_edit_finish_iteration14.py covering upload flow + final-gate red→green transition + rough_cut faculty approval + final approval blocked→green). No fixes required, no code changed by testing agent.
critical_code_review_comments: EditFinish.jsx uses `api.delete('/finish/' + 'version' + '/' + id)` (line 166) — the concatenation with a literal 'version' via template interpolation is confusing dead-style code. Should be `api.delete('/finish/version/' + id)` for readability.
server.py has grown to 2284 lines — carrying the same recommendation as iteration 13: split media / finish / ai endpoints into modules.

EditFinish page loads the entire finish overview then makes a SECOND request to `/finish/final-gate` inside DeliveryTab (line 429). Could be consolidated into the overview payload to reduce network chatter — the overview already computes rights/accessibility/delivery state.

The `<video>` src now embeds the JWT as a query string — this token WILL land in nginx access logs and any Referer header if the video is embedded elsewhere. Acceptable for demo; document in security README before production.
resolveAssetUrl reads getToken() at render time on every asset URL — if the token is rotated mid-session, existing
